pitUniverse.rule: At each 15m decision, both Spot SYMBOLUSDT and USD-M perpetual must have complete PIT 5m data, be listed at that time, and have at least 90 days of prior archive history; no current-universe backfill.

immutableArchives.cachePolicy: Verified ZIP and .CHECKSUM are written once; an existing path with a different digest is a hard failure.

timestampNormalization.rule: Normalize source seconds/milliseconds/microseconds to UTC milliseconds; Spot and USD-M Futures are checked independently.

completeness.note: Coverage requirements are not met; no returns or strategy metrics were read.
